verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents a first-party choice of storage location per project: Local Vault, Cloud Sync, or Git Sync. With Git Sync, data stays in any third-party Git repository you pick and Insomnia does not host it, so you can keep data local or in infrastructure you control. However, nothing shows that Cloud Sync lets you pick a hosting region or offers formal data-residency guarantees. missing for 10: selectable cloud storage region, documented data-residency commitments (e.g. EU/US hosting), independent corroboration.
